reviews.title: Align it right when installing
reviews.comment: This took quite a bit of effort to get the macBook Air a1466 to recognize.  What I found is that the card allowed me to misalign it.  After the first install, it wasn't recognized.  I tried using the disk utility -> view, but no dice.  I then re-openned the macBook, and then pulled the SSD back as far as the screw would allow and did my best to line it up straight.  Then it was able to see the SSD.  I was able to format it, and install macOS to it. The reason it didn't get the full 5 stars is that I had to jump through the hoops to make it work.
reviews.author: Glen

reviews.title: Simple replacement for a failing HD.
reviews.comment: Easy replacement for my failing HD on my Mac Air 2017.  Just popped it in and used the mac's built-in recovery software to download the latest compatible OS from Apple.  I had already backed up personal data to an external drive. Saved a bunch over what was quoted to me by the "geniuses".
reviews.author: Chris G
